name: Product Compare Hub – Product Comparison Table & Catalog
author: SvetiX

sections.description:
No support is included. The Lite plugin and the separate Pro plugin include plugin updates only. There is no support by email, no support on the WordPress.org forum, and no support during the 7-day Pro trial.

Product Compare Hub turns WordPress into a product catalog with comparison — for laptops, headphones, bikes, coffee machines, phones, services, anything that has specifications. You decide which characteristics describe your products; the plugin builds the product editor, the filters, the spec sheets and the comparison table around them. No coding, no page builder required: one shortcode.

What visitors get

  • Live search and filters by brand, category and every attribute you flagged as a filter, with a result counter and “load more”.
  • Product pages with one main image, description, price, release date and the full spec sheet grouped by attribute group.
  • Side-by-side comparison: visitors pick as many products as you allow and open a comparison table with every attribute. There is no built-in cap.
  • 3 colour themes (one light, one dark, one neutral) and a toolbar layout that adapts to your theme. System fonts, no external requests.
  • Every product also gets its own page automatically (SEO friendly URLs you can rename).

What you get in the admin

  • Your own attribute schema: groups (Display, Performance, Battery, Materials…) and attributes of type text, number with unit, list of values, yes/no or long text. Drag to reorder. Tick “Filter” to offer an attribute as a catalog filter and “Card” to show it on the catalog card.
  • Unlimited products with name, subtitle, short and long description, brand, category, release date, price and one main image.
  • Brands and categories as regular WordPress taxonomies.
  • Catalog order by release date, name, date added or price.
  • Sample catalog: 20 fictional products installed at the start so you can see everything working right away (removable with one click).
  • A built-in “How it works” guide.

Shortcodes

  • [svpcx_catalog] — the full catalog with search, filters and comparison.
  • [svpcx_catalog category="laptops" per_page="8"] — a filtered catalog (also brand="...").
  • [svpcx_product id="123"] — one product’s page inside any page.

Free edition vs Pro

This plugin, as hosted on WordPress.org, is the Lite edition. It is free and fully functional within its scope: unlimited products, your own attribute schema with every attribute type, live search and filters, product pages with one main image, unlimited side-by-side comparison of all attributes, 3 colour themes, the toolbar layout, brands and categories, catalog order by date, name or price, the sample catalog and the two shortcodes above. Nothing in this package is locked behind a license, a trial, a time limit or a quota; the interface follows your WordPress site language and community translations.

A separate Pro plugin is sold from our site and is not part of this package. It adds:

  • 5 interface languages (English, Italian, French, German, Serbian) with a per-visitor flag switcher.
  • 12 colour themes plus custom accent colours.
  • 3 layouts: toolbar filters, sidebar filters, full width.
  • Colour variants with an image gallery per colour and a lightbox.
  • A glossary of technical terms with “i” popups next to attributes.
  • “Show only differences” in the comparison table.
  • Related products and highlights on the product page.
  • Manual drag & drop ordering of products and brands.
  • The fixed comparison shortcode [svpcx_compare ids="12,15"].
  • An installable web app (home-screen icon, full screen).

Pro can be tried for 7 days. Pro includes plugin updates only: no support (by email or on the WordPress.org forum) and no refunds. Live demo.

Privacy

The plugin does not collect personal data from visitors and sets no cookies. See “External services” for the one optional connection (Freemius), off until you turn it on.

External services

The catalog itself never sends visitor data anywhere: products, attributes and settings stay in your WordPress database, fonts come from the visitor’s system and no cookie is set. One optional connection exists, off until you turn it on.

Freemius (bundled SDK, vendor/freemius) manages the optional upgrade to the separate Pro plugin, its licenses and its updates. The Pro trial lasts 7 days and includes plugin updates only. It does not include support, by email or on the WordPress.org forum. On activation Freemius shows an opt-in screen: only if you accept, basic site and usage data (site URL, WordPress/PHP version, plugin version, admin e-mail) are sent to Freemius. You can skip the opt-in and this Lite plugin works fully without any external connection. Service by Freemius, Inc.: terms https://freemius.com/terms/ – privacy policy https://freemius.com/privacy/

Links to the Pro checkout (https://checkout.freemius.com) and to the demo (https://svetix.ch/spacetool/) open only when you click them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate it. A sample catalog of 20 fictional products is created so you can see it working (remove it with one click in Settings > Tools).
  3. Go to Compare Hub > Attributes and adapt the attribute groups to your products.
  4. Add your products under Compare Hub > Add new product.
  5. Create a page and insert [svpcx_catalog]. Done.
sections.faq:
Is support included?

No. Lite and Pro include plugin updates only. There is no support by email, no support on this forum, and no support during the 7-day Pro trial.

Can I compare products of different kinds?

Yes. The attribute schema is shared, so products of different categories can be compared; attributes a product does not have are simply shown as “not specified”.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Product Compare Hub is independent: it is a catalog and comparison tool, not a shop. You can add a price and any link you like in the description.

How do the filters work?

Every attribute flagged as “Filter” (plus brand and category) becomes a filter group. Filters combine with the live search and update the results without reloading the page.

Can I change the URL of product pages?

Yes, in Compare Hub > Settings (“URL slug of product pages”).

Does it work with block themes?

Yes, with both classic and block (FSE) themes.

Which languages are included?

The Lite edition speaks the language of your WordPress site: its strings are translatable through translate.wordpress.org and language packs are installed automatically when available. The per-visitor flag switcher with five bundled languages is part of the Pro plugin.

What happens to my data if I switch from Pro back to Lite?

Nothing is deleted. Products, attributes, brands, categories and settings stay in the database; the catalog, product pages and comparison keep working. Only the Pro-specific pieces (colour galleries, glossary popups, extra themes and layouts, language switcher) stop being displayed until Pro is active again.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Lite edition: the free package now contains the catalog, filters, product pages with one main image, the side-by-side comparison, 3 colour themes and the toolbar layout. Products and comparison stay unlimited.
  • Moved to the separate Pro plugin: flag language switcher and bundled translations, 9 of the 12 colour themes and custom accent colours, sidebar and full-width layouts, colour variants with galleries and lightbox, glossary popups, “show only differences”, related products and highlights, manual drag & drop ordering, [svpcx_compare], the web app.
  • Catalog can be ordered by price.
  • Google Fonts option removed: the catalog uses the visitor’s system fonts, so the plugin makes no external request.
  • Interface language follows the WordPress site language (standard translation files from translate.wordpress.org).
  • Existing data is kept: a saved theme or layout that no longer exists falls back to the default, and a product whose only picture was in a colour gallery gets it as main image.

1.2.5

  • Comparison is unlimited. This package does not cap the number of products.
  • Printed markup is escaped.
  • Internal names use a longer prefix.
  • The separate Pro trial is 7 days and includes updates only, not support.

1.2.4

  • The language switcher is included and works without a license.
  • Translation text domain matches the plugin slug.
  • Inputs used for nonces, the current address and colour image lists are sanitized.

1.2.3

  • Plugin name is Product Compare Hub.

1.2.2

  • Translation text domain is a fixed string, as required by the WordPress.org plugin check.

1.2.1

  • Directory name is Product Compare Hub.
  • Removed Freemius development files that are not part of the plugin.
  • Documented the optional Freemius and Google Fonts connections. Both stay off until you turn them on.

1.2.0

  • Directory edition: unlimited products, comparison of up to 6, and the language switcher. The installable web app is a separate plugin.
  • Google Fonts loading is now off by default.

1.1.2

  • Demo build: the demo admin also sees the Dashboard, the Media library and an editable test page.
  • Plugin description lists the 5 interface languages and the web app.

1.1.1

  • Release dates on the site follow the chosen language (month names).
  • Pages served from a cache in another language are reloaded in the visitor’s language.
  • Web app: better default short name.

1.1.0

  • Five languages: English, Italian, French, German and Serbian, with a flag switcher for visitors.
  • Default attribute, group, glossary and sample category names are shown in the visitor’s language.
  • Installable web app (PWA) for phones and tablets.
  • New “How it works” guide page in the admin.
  • Own capability set (svpcx_manage, edit_svpcx_products…).

1.0.1

  • Better compatibility with dark themes; in-place demo reset.

1.0.0

  • First release.
